verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs claim AI-generated insights on the user's own data (codebase) — tracing repo structure, root-causing issues, and reviewing diffs — which maps to this story for a dev-tool context, but these are all first-party doc claims with no independent validation of insight quality. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence that these insights are reliable, and any richer analytics-style suggestion capability beyond code navigation/debugging.
